newsitem.title: INDIA: Seven hacked to death in India in revenge killings.
newsitem.headline: Seven hacked to death in India in revenge killings.

text.p: Bengali Hindus in the northeast Indian state of Assam were suspected of hacking to death seven Bodo tribals on Monday in apparent revenge killings, police officials said.

Six Bodo tribesmen died in Nabinagar village, in Nalbari district, 40 km (25 miles) west of Guwahati, a senior Assam police officer told Reuters. In a nearby village, Hindus hacked another Bodo tribesman to death.
On Friday night, 13 Bengali Hindus had been massaced by Bodo guerrillas who raided two villages near Tamulpur in Nalbari district, the officer said.
Militant Bodo tribesman launched a violent campaign for a separate province in Assam in 1985, blaming the ruling Assamese community of depriving them of their basic rights.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in their campaign for a separate province, police and hospital authorities say.
